text: Solo Worker OS turns a freelancer's scattered business admin into one private, conversational workflow.
The provider is local. The Radeon-hosted model is reachable, and Qwen three, four B is being served through vee L L M.
I describe a new client in plain Chinese: the work, budget, and deadline. The agent extracts those details and calls create project. No form filling.
In the next turn, it reuses that project context and calls generate contract. The service agreement includes the client, fee, deadline, and working terms.
Each run is observable. The trace records the router decision, model call, tool execution, result, and latency.
The new project now appears in the business workspace. The recording is backed by a dedicated AMD Radeon GPU running rock em, vee L L M, and Qwen three, four B.
